g.text: Native supervision; converters, firmware, PCB and implant qualification remain

g.text: 18 guarded stimulation conductors, 17 measured RHD-side windows; conditional healthy-switch blanking is not proven isolation.

g.text: Independent phase cap, heartbeat watchdog, rail windows and deliberate rearm have different functions. No automatic retry or reverse pulse.

g.text: All net labels are native electrical connections. Actual physical delay, leakage, failed switches and shared supplies remain bounded limitations.
